Buy King () is an upcoming South Korean television series written by Shinho Lee, directed by Jo Sung-hee and starring Ju Ji-hoon. The series explores Korean chaebol family dynamics, depicting complex relationships and power struggles for control of a multi-billion dollar empire.
Synopsis
Cast
* Ju Ji-hoon as Han Tae-jun
Production
In March 2026, Ju Ji-hoon had been cast as the lead. Directed by Jo Sung-hee, who helmed A Werewolf Boy (2012) and Space Sweepers (2021), and penned by Shinho Lee, the drama will consists 10 episodes, with more than 8 scripts already completed.
